module: Flowgraph node "im Vehicle Selector" (category once_instant, tags imgui/vehicle/config): imgui vehicle selection window based on editor/util/vehicleSelectUtil. Outputs: "selected" (flow after the Select button), "model", "config", "configPath" and, hidden, "paintName1/2/3". Options in data: enableConfigs (true), enablePaints (false), enableCustomConfig (false).
notes: The "selected" flow is reset to false only when the node is reset.

_executionStarted.desc: Creates the selection utility with the data options.

displayWindow.desc: Draws the "Vehicle Select" window (widget, Select and Reset buttons) and updates the outputs.

builder.desc: Editor node builder (builder:Middle() opens the central area).

style.desc: Node display style provided by the editor.

onNodeReset.desc: Closes the window and resets selected to false.
